# B"H — Perutas Budgets (geelooy/api/perutas/budgets/)

Budget management for peruta-denominated accounts.

- `budgetService.js` — budget lifecycle
- `budgetGuardService.js` — spend guards enforcing budget limits

Aggregated as `budgets` / `budgetGuard` in `../index.js`.
